seed_notes.ABANTU_BATHO_CONGRESS: entrant from nothing: even share of every pool. Sized at the EXPECTED result for the 45 arrivals that contested about as much of a city (18% of wards): mean 0.21%, median 0.04%, band 0.03%-1.32%. THE EVEN SPREAD IS A PLACEHOLDER: declare which pools it pulls from and what support you expect. | group rescaled x0.35: 18 entrants summing to 4.64% against an arrival-total record of 1.62%
